# Original updater fixture observations

`git-original.json` is a source-free projection of the unchanged Python `updated_fixtures.py` seed/setup/normalize capture from [run 39529853741](https://github.com/bin9208/openpilot-rust/actions/runs/39529853741), artifact `12314388276` (ZIP SHA-256 `bb324383fc207fbbbb111183a009706051a967af7dffc8c8ceffd55f6fbc92f2`). The raw artifact member `original.json` has SHA-256 `5111de95c85fecc0a5d367097652ac3fbffe9607ed2e6eab239f4af445746548`; its projected file here has SHA-256 `3a859802faa1b1c080def7260c31baf0cc7fe8e94ba7efdd182a03d3090fdc1a`. The diagnostic workflow head was `219f13d8f61c4012ca13291ac8cd576a1d9007ff`; the checked-out source was `20a8f52e83d85c7c5113c5484179b0c016a034eb`.

`overlay-original.json` is a source-free projection of the unchanged Python overlay-command capture from [run 39531041668](https://github.com/bin9208/openpilot-rust/actions/runs/39531041668), artifact `12315223271` (ZIP SHA-256 `88d6a2a3b832a35cf1e3a5ce39a5660f748426c7e7063645bc760cd3284ef360`). The raw artifact member `original/overlay.json` has SHA-256 `3aee09430978c6c2b736bc8bc45c8ce0d049e98f358a7f41e764f01a953606c2`; its projected file here has SHA-256 `338900085dc7b31c68fc1c743fc19e128679cb63e59a487307f86af6a49d3947`. Its workflow head was `f0675c52ca8b1c48568a91547fa4a32c0a402e0e`; the checked-out source was `ce145d062ad24f71da3e49e9b8b4fc676b35ef41`.

Neither committed JSON is byte-for-byte the raw artifact. To produce `git-original.json`, parse raw `original.json`, remove only `/lanes/native/entries/bin~1sudo/hex` and `/lanes/source/entries/bin~1sudo/hex`, and add `byte_count: 951` at each parent object. To produce `overlay-original.json`, remove only `raw_hex` from all 12 `/scenarios/<case>/<row>/tree/bin~1sudo/raw_hex` pointers (cases: `errors` rows 0–3, `nested-symlink-outside` row 0, `repeat` rows 0–1, `success` rows 0–3, `symlink-outside` row 0) and add `byte_count: 951` at each parent. The count comes from decoding each original hex string; its SHA-256 matches the retained `sha256` field `3110cc0a1f9b57cdba2133d7d515121e6e47dae3fbe228f77527df861efb041d`. All 14 entries retain their paths, `kind: file`, and `mode: 493` (0755). Serialize the otherwise unchanged JSON with sorted keys, two-space indentation, ASCII escaping and a trailing newline. This removes only generated Python implementation bytes; every case, command, and other observation remains. `SHA256SUMS` lists the projected files. The maintained original helper hash is `76607e02520f383227264257de0ed8505b9dc12e462227b176f2c919dfec2d60`. The native tests intentionally reject the two observed out-of-root symlink cases and require their private sentinels to remain unchanged.

The five `updated_fixture_original` tests read these committed bytes directly and still require `UPDATED_FIXTURE_NATIVE_OUTPUT` to retain native observations. For the two controller absence tests, Actions must set `UPDATED_FIXTURE_REQUIRE_ABSENT=0` before helper deletion and `=1` after deletion. Both private admission roots omit the helper even when it is present in the checkout; the current checkout helper, if present, remains exact-hash and inode pinned through each controller run. No helper deletion is justified until those joint same-ELF cloud lanes pass with unchanged scenario, daemon, and execution rosters.
